notes: A black Fenix EFB (brightness 0) is set to 37.5 % within about 5 seconds of Fenix's gateway answering: TechLog looks every 5 seconds for 30 seconds, with one last look at the end. A Settings switch turns it off.
TechLog started with the Fenix stops the moment the Fenix is unloaded, whatever is open. The starter looks every second.
The EFB repair no longer waits for the aircraft to be parked, and each look is written in the TechLog window.
